(3) In section 18(1) (initial procedure) after “either way” there shall be inserted “and—
(a) he indicates under section 17A above that (if the offence were to
proceed to trial) he would plead not guilty, or
(b) his representative indicates under section 17B above that (if the
offence were to proceed to trial) he would plead not guilty”.

(4) [F106In section 19 (court to consider which mode of trial appears more suitable)
paragraph (a) of subsection (2) (charge to be read to accused) shall be omitted.]

(5) In—
(a) subsections (1A), (3A), (3C) and (3E) of section 128 (remand), and
(b) subsection (1) of section 130 (transfer of remand hearings),
after “10(1)” there shall be inserted “ , 17C ”.

(6) This section applies where a person appears or is brought before a magistrates’ court
on or after the appointed day, unless he has appeared or been brought before such a
court in respect of the same offence on a previous occasion falling before that day.
